$comment: A quantum vault, grade low (IDEAL-MACHINES-PLAN decisions 14–18, the grade table; IM-6's pass, decision 6). One 1 m body holding 100 m³ of blocks and water together, on its channel's store. Its hold bill follows what it holds: 25 W a cubic metre of water and 2.5 W of blocks, paid from the channel's pool each boundary, or from its own minute (ownChargeSeconds) when the pool falls short. A bill unpaid once that minute is spent lights a 10–20 s fuse, and a burnt fuse dumps everything it holds. Every number is an estimate for his tuning. Its name on screen comes from the ID: quantum vault (low).
